*In plain English: Robinhood's stock tokens are debt securities that track a stock's price. They give you no shareholder rights.*

Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited under a [base prospectus](https://cdn.robinhood.com/assets/robinhood/legal/rhj_base_prospectus.pdf); they give economic exposure without rights in the underlying ([docs](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens/); [product page](https://robinhood.com/rhj/stocktokens/)). Separately, EU **Classic** Stock Tokens are MiFID II derivatives ([FAQ](https://robinhood.com/eu/en/support/articles/stock-tokens-faq/)).

On Robinhood Chain, trading at launch is via [[concepts/glossary#rfq|RFQ]] plus [[concepts/glossary#amm|AMMs]] and Lighter, with onchain price feeds ([Robinhood](https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/building-with-stock-tokens/)). Mainnet announcement: [Arbitrum](https://blog.arbitrum.io/robinhood-chain-mainnet/).

## Adoption
Bitwise's Q4 2026 staking report says average daily Stock Token volume on Robinhood Chain rose 22x from July to September 2026, and that the chain earned over \$50M in fees in its first quarter ([Bitwise](https://bitwiseinvestments.com/crypto-market-insights/the-bitwise-staking-report-q4-2026), analysis; summary page only, the full report was not retrieved). Monthly volumes of \$526M (July), \$2.21B (August) and \$11.31B (September) come from [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html) citing Bitwise (news; unverified, not on Bitwise's summary page).

# Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/securitize
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary)
status: live (Securitize Stocks launched 2026-10-08)
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary)  
> **Status:** live (Securitize Stocks launched 2026-10-08)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares) |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Securitize Stocks; issuer-sponsored tokenized shares |
| structure | Securitize Stocks: UCC Article 8 security entitlements, 1:1 backed, via Securitize's broker-dealer; also issuer-sponsored shares |
| chains | Algorand (Exodus), Ethereum (per Zerion, secondary), Solana (per Zerion, secondary), Avalanche (per Zerion, secondary) |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | 12 companies at launch (CoinDesk) |

*In plain English: Securitize acts as transfer agent and tokenization platform for funds and companies that issue tokens.*

Example: Exodus Class A common stock tokens on Algorand, with Securitize as [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/exodus-issues-security-token-on-algorand-expanding-access-to-the-growing-digital-security-ecosystem-301304582.html)); trading began on Securitize Markets in March 2022 ([Securitize](https://securitize.io/press-releases/exodus-begins-trading-on-securitize-markets)).

## Securitize Stocks (8 Oct 2026)
Launched stocks as UCC Article 8 security entitlements, 1:1 backed, on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]], settled in USDC, through Securitize's [[concepts/glossary#broker-dealer|broker-dealer]]; Jump makes markets on the PropAMM; conversion to direct registration where available; NYSE and OKXICE venues planned ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-us-stocks-with-security-entitlements-302902107.html); [RQD](https://rqdclearing.com/securitize-launches-global-onchain-trading-of-u-s-stocks-with-security-entitlements/)). CoinDesk reported 12 companies at launch ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/10/08/securitize-brings-apple-nvidia-and-tesla-to-solana-with-nyse-trading-in-the-works), news).

# Superstate Opening Bell
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/superstate-opening-bell
type: issuer
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: Ethereum, Solana
status: live
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** Ethereum, Solana  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Superstate Opening Bell |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Tokenized company shares (e.g. GLXY) |
| structure | Actual company shares (e.g. Galaxy Class A common) |
| chains | Ethereum, Solana |
| who_can_buy | KYC-verified investors in self-custody wallets |
| num_assets | 3 on RWA.xyz |

*In plain English: Superstate's Opening Bell puts real company shares on a blockchain, with Superstate keeping the official shareholder register.*

Galaxy (GLXY) Class A common stock is tokenized on [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] via Opening Bell; Superstate, an SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]], updates ownership records ([Galaxy](https://www.galaxy.com/newsroom/galaxy-superstate-launch-glxy-tokenized-public-shares); [Superstate docs](https://docs.superstate.com/investors/tokenized-equities)).

Superstate acts as SEC-registered transfer agent and keeps the cap table onchain ([Superstate](https://www.superstate.com/opening-bell)). Galaxy's research describes [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allowlisted]] self-custody and transfer-agent mechanics ([Galaxy](https://www.galaxy.com/insights/research/tokenized-glxy)); launch exhibit on EDGAR ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859392/000185939225000052/galaxyxsuperstateoblaunchf.htm)).

# xStocks (Backed)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/xstocks-backed
type: issuer
jurisdiction: Jersey
chain: Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025)
status: live (since 2025-06-30)
last_updated: 2026-10-25

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** issuer  
> **Jurisdiction:** Jersey  
> **Chain:** Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025)  
> **Status:** live (since 2025-06-30)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-25  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | xStocks (Backed) |
| jurisdiction | Jersey |
| product_name | xStocks |
| structure | Tokenized certificates/tracker tokens backed by custodied securities |
| chains | Solana, Ethereum, TON, Ink, (Tron, Mantle, BNB Chain announced as coming, Dec 2025) |
| who_can_buy | Eligible non-US persons; excluded in US, UK, Canada, Australia and sanctioned jurisdictions |
| num_assets | 131 (Kraken FAQ, 2026-10-25; 100 stocks, 27 ETFs, 4 specialist) |

*In plain English: xStocks are tokens backed one-for-one by US stocks and ETFs.*

xStocks are stock and ETF tokens issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, backed 1:1 by the underlying asset. They launched on Bybit, Kraken and [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] DeFi on 30 June 2025 ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

On 2 December 2025 Kraken announced it **agreed to acquire** Backed Finance AG ([Kraken](https://blog.kraken.com/news/backed-acquisition); [Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251202666578/en/Kraken-to-Acquire-Backed-Accelerating-xStocks-Expansion-and-Unlocking-Global-Demand-for-Tokenized-Equities)); completion status not confirmed here.

At that date xStocks offered more than 60 assets, live on Solana and [[concepts/glossary#ethereum|Ethereum]]. xStocks are not available in the US ([Kraken press release](https://www.payward.com/press-release/kraken-acquires-backed-xstocks-expansion)). Kraken's xStocks FAQ now lists 131 assets (100 stocks, 27 ETFs, 4 specialist assets) on Solana, Ethereum, TON and Ink, for eligible non-US clients in 110+ countries; not the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).

A figure of 1,100 assets advertised elsewhere ([Zerion](https://zerion.io/blog/best-tokenized-stock-platforms/), secondary) is unverified and not used.

Corporate actions use a [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/developers/multipliers)): dividends are reinvested net of withholding and raise the multiplier ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/dividends-and-stock-splits)); holders get no voting rights ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)); see [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]]; exchange integration and API: [integration](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/exchange-integration), [OpenAPI](https://docs.xstocks.fi/apis/openapi.md).

- <https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251202666578/en/Kraken-to-Acquire-Backed-Accelerating-xStocks-Expansion-and-Unlocking-Global-Demand-for-Tokenized-Equities>

# Nasdaq tokenized securities rule
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Nasdaq tokenized securities rule |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | SR-NASDAQ-2025-072 |
| structure | Same security, tokenized form; same CUSIP/ticker/rights, same order book |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | DTC Pilot eligible participants |
| num_assets | Russell 1000 constituents + certain ETPs |

*In plain English: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.*

The SEC approved Nasdaq's rule on 18 March 2026, enabling tokenized trading during [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]]'s tokenization pilot ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).

Original notice: [SEC Rel. 34-103989](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2025/34-103989.pdf). The approval keeps tokenized shares on the same book with the same priority, [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]], symbol and rights, settling through the DTC pilot; see [[concepts/post-trade-reg-nms-model|post-trade / Reg NMS model]].

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-03-23/html/2026-05563.htm>
- <https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/nasdaq-receives-sec-nod-trading-tokenized-securities-2026-03-18/>
- <https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2025/34-103989.pdf>

# NYSE / ICE tokenized securities
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: rule filed; platform in development
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** rule filed; platform in development  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | NYSE / ICE tokenized securities |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | SR-NYSE-2026-17; planned 24/7 platform |
| structure | Same security, tokenized form (DTC pilot); planned 24/7 venue |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot.*

NYSE filed SR-NYSE-2026-17 (Rel. 34-105260), an immediately effective rule along the lines of Nasdaq's and tied to the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] pilot ([NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/markets/nyse/rule-filings/sec-approvals/2026/%28SR-NYSE-2026-17%29_34-105260.pdf)).

Separately, ICE announced on 19 Jan 2026 that NYSE is developing a platform for 24/7 trading of tokenized equities and [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] with instant settlement and [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoin]] funding, subject to approval and DTC readiness ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/The-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Develops-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/)).

No technical spec or launch date was found.

# OKXICE TSV
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/okxice-tsv
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States (TSV Exemption)
chain: unknown
status: TSV notice published 2026-10-04
last_updated: 2026-10-25

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (TSV Exemption)  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** TSV notice published 2026-10-04  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-25  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | OKXICE TSV |
| jurisdiction | United States (TSV Exemption) |
| product_name | Tokenized Securities Venue |
| structure | Permissioned AMM (Uniswap v4 hook) |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Holders of access soulbound tokens; U.S. person conditions per order |
| num_assets | 63 symbols listed in notice |

*In plain English: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.*

The first public [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], dated 4 Oct 2026 ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)). Design per the notice: Uniswap v4 pools with an OKXICE TSV hook, access via soulbound tokens, pairs against USDC/USDG/USDT, no order book and no custody; it describes admin-key governance.

The notice lists 63 symbols ([Dida Labs](https://didalabs.com/tokenized-stock-objection/), analysis). Dida Labs notes Cerebras is not among the 63 ([Dida Labs](https://didalabs.com/tokenized-stock-objection/)); OKXICE's own notices list it as an objector (see below). Coverage: [Ledger Insights](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/ice-okx-venture-plans-trading-of-tokenized-us-stocks-via-uniswap-pools/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/okx-ice-uniswap-v4-hooks-tokenized-stocks/) (news).

## Issuer objections
OKXICE's public notice of 23 Oct 2026 lists **22** issuers that objected: Cerebras (CBRS), AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, Verizon, Applied Optoelectronics, Broadcom, UnitedHealth, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's, Western Digital, Alphabet (GOOG/GOOGL), Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell ([OKXICE notice, 23 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.23.pdf)).

The first 16 were already on its 19 Oct notice; Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell are new ([OKXICE notice, 19 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.19.pdf)). CNBC's 21 Oct count of 16 matches the 19 Oct notice ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html), news).

Cerebras appears as an objector even though it was not among the 63 symbols in the 4 Oct notice; neither notice says why (possibly an objection filed ahead of a listing; unverified). Under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] the venue must notify each issuer and wait 30 days after receipt before trading ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html)).

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://didalabs.com/tokenized-stock-objection/>
- <https://www.ledgerinsights.com/ice-okx-venture-plans-trading-of-tokenized-us-stocks-via-uniswap-pools/>
- <https://cryptobriefing.com/okx-ice-uniswap-v4-hooks-tokenized-stocks/>
- <https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html>
- <https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/exorders/2026/34-106402.pdf>

# Chainlink tokenized equity feeds
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: live
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** live  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Chainlink tokenized equity feeds |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | Tokenized Equity Feeds; Data Streams |
| structure | Oracle |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | n/a |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.*

Feeds combine the underlying 24/5 equity price with the issuer's [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] and respect issuer-controlled oracle pauses; issuer-specific pages exist for Coinbase [[concepts/glossary#b20|B20]] and Robinhood ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds)).

Data Streams price regular, extended and overnight sessions with market-status flags and staleness checks ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/rwa-streams/24-5-us-equities-user-guide)). For splits: pause the feed, stage the new multiplier, unpause; the issuer coordinates timing and Chainlink provides no corporate-action calendar ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/tokenized-asset-streams/handling-stock-splits)).

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds>
- <https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/rwa-streams/24-5-us-equities-user-guide>
- <https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/tokenized-asset-streams/handling-stock-splits>

# DTCC / DTC tokenization pilot
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle)
status: pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)
last_updated: 2026-10-23

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle)  
> **Status:** pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-23  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | DTCC / DTC tokenization pilot |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | DTC Tokenization Service (Tokenized Entitlements) |
| structure | Security entitlements recorded on DLT |
| chains | At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle) |
| who_can_buy | DTC participants |
| num_assets | 25 securities at launch (~$30T eligible): select Russell 1000 equities, ETFs, Treasuries |

*In plain English: DTC, the US central securities depository, is testing tokenized versions of shares it already holds.*

DTC operates a tokenization pilot under a 11 Dec 2025 SEC no-action letter ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)); 24X Exchange filed rules referencing it ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/self-regulatory-organization-rulemaking/sr-24x-2026-20)).

## DTC no-action letter (11 Dec 2025)
Staff relief lets DTC participants record security entitlements on [[concepts/glossary#dlt|DLT]] ("Tokenized Entitlements") for Russell 1000 stocks, major-index [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] and Treasuries; tokens have no collateral or settlement value for Net Debit Cap / Collateral Monitor ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf); [Mayer Brown](https://www.mayerbrown.com/-/media/files/perspectives-events/publications/2025/12/sec-staff-no-action-relief-for-dtc-pilot-provides-a-pathway-for-tokenized-securities.pdf)). The letter is withdrawn three years from the date DTC launches the service ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf)).
## Progress
DTCC said the service was designed with feedback from more than 50 firms, with limited production trades planned for July 2026 and launch in October 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-advances-development-of-new-tokenization-service)). About 40 firms took part in live production trades ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/digital-assets/tokenization/live-production-trades); [DTCC press](https://www.dtcc.com/news/2026/july/15/dtcc-turns-tokenization-into-reality)).

On 23 Oct 2026 DTCC posted a Day 1 product tear sheet and an online user guide to its Learning Center ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)).

As of 25 Oct 2026, no DTCC go-live press release was found; The Block (8 Oct 2026) reported launch was expected that month ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/tokenization-briefing/2026-10-08-dtcc-brings-tokenization-us-markets-417839), secondary).

## Scope at launch (Oct 2026)
DTCC's Day 1 tear sheet (23 Oct 2026) says **34** securities are available to tokenize at launch ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)); its earlier at-a-glance sheet said 25 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)), and DTCC does not explain the change.

Other launch terms in the at-a-glance sheet, unchanged in the tear sheet:  about \$30T eligible, backed 1:1 by securities held at DTC, same [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]] and the same rights and investor protections as book-entry securities, and 24/7 peer-to-peer transfers between DTC-registered [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallets]] on the same chain ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Live at launch: Canton Network (CIP-56) and Besu, DTCC's private network ([[concepts/glossary#erc-20|ERC-20]]); Stellar and Circle's Arc are anticipated in 2027 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). Eligible assets start with select large-cap Russell 1000 equities, select ETFs and a select set of Treasury bills, notes and bonds ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Conversion orders run 2 a.m.-6 p.m. ET on business days, targeting 15 minutes or less; tokens carry transfer restrictions; official books and records stay with DTC; Treasury distributions and maturities pay in fiat to participants' traditional accounts ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Roadmap for 2027 and beyond (indicative): equity/ETF corporate actions, a consolidated stock record, on-chain [[concepts/glossary#netting|netting]] and digital cash ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). Coverage: [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/dtcc-tokenization-service-launch-october/) (news).

Firm counts differ by source and stage: more than 50 firms gave design feedback and about 40 took part in live production trades (DTCC); Crypto Briefing's "more than 30" is secondary and is not used here.

## Watch
- Go-live: DTCC says October 2026 but gives no date; "end of October" comes from Digital Asset's CEO via [CantonNews](https://cantonnews.org/dtcc-details-its-tokenization-service-canton-live-at-launch-25-securities-and-a-2027-roadmap) (news). Check for a DTCC go-live release after 2026-10-31.
- First named users: none named yet in DTCC materials. Record them when announced.

# Uniswap v4 permissioned pools
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/uniswap-permissioned-pools
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: unknown
last_updated: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** unknown  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Uniswap v4 permissioned pools |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | PermissionedHooks |
| structure | Permissioned AMM hook |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Allowlisted addresses (issuer-defined) |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.*

An open-source Uniswap v4 hook standard for compliant trading of tokenized [[concepts/glossary#rwa|RWAs]] and equities; issuer [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allowlists]] are enforced on every swap and liquidity [[concepts/glossary#mint|mint]] ([Uniswap](https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4)).

A Permissions Adapter holds the real asset and issues a virtual token to PoolManager; PermissionedHooks checks an IAllowlistChecker ([architecture](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture); [source](https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol)).

It is the AMM primitive used by the first [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice ([[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE]]).

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4>
- <https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture>
- <https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol>

*Last checked 2026-10-17. Headline fields only; `unknown` means not yet verified from a source.*
